title: Signup email link arrives and signs you in
instructions: Go to /start and sign up with a real inbox you control (e.g. you+test@gmail.com). The sign-in email should arrive within a minute; clicking it should land on onboarding. Afterwards, delete the test account's workspace from /admin/modules.

title: Stripe Connect onboarding completes
instructions: In a test workspace: Billing → Connect Stripe. Finish Stripe's hosted onboarding (test mode). Back on Billing it should say "Payments are on".

title: Google consent screen shows the VisionWorkx name and both permissions
instructions: In a test workspace: Settings → Connect Google Calendar with your own account. The screen should name VisionWorkx (not revalorllc.com) and list exactly two calendar permissions. Then Disconnect (only on your own test workspace — never on Revalor QA Calendar).

title: Disconnect removes access in the Google Account
instructions: After disconnecting your own test connection, check myaccount.google.com → Security → Third-party connections: VisionWorkx should no longer be listed.

title: 24-hour reminder email arrives
instructions: Book a time about 25 hours ahead with your real email. The next day, the reminder should arrive about 24 hours before, with a working change/cancel link.
